tests.name: Load uses original-state endpoint and never reads localStorage

Updates coalesce and always carry server revision
Pending caller object is copied before transport
Identical state produces no extra write
Read-only state does not bypass server write setting
Network error is retained and not blindly retried
Revision conflict does not overwrite current server state
Edits while saving serialize with next revision
Project target and scope are distinct channels
Logout clears cached state and pending timers
Server warning is visible instead of silent fallback
Wizard first step does not create records
Wizard review calls read-only preflight not create
Back preserves typed details and invalidates review
Creating twice sends one original command
Stay-on-confirmation option does not trigger project switch
Ambiguous create failure latches against duplicate creation
Definitive validation error retains fields and allows repair
Query persistence remains bound to original project
Detached or other-project tabs cannot save preferences
Late table response after project switch is discarded
Late table response after tab close is discarded
Late metadata cannot reopen tab in another project
Late restored state cannot reopen detached project view
Sidebar response cannot replace new project navigation
Nested query response cannot save under replacement target
Nested preference restoration checks target after await
Unmounted nested widget rejects pending state restoration
